##### Project general facts

Element Residence is a premium waterfront development in Canggu, Bali, designed as a contemporary lifestyle destination that blends architecture, nature, and resort-style living. The project comprises 107 residences arranged across four residential blocks — Air, Water, Earth and Fire. Residence formats include studios, duplex garden residences and duplex penthouses, several offering ocean views. The development is positioned as a branded five-star hospitality residence, combining hotel-grade services with private residential ownership under a 50-year leasehold structure. The design concept is inspired by natural elements, creating a harmonious living environment where light, space, and organic materials come together to form a refined yet relaxed atmosphere.

Residents enjoy access to a wide range of amenities, including a main pool area with lounge spaces, a rooftop restaurant, a fully equipped gym, wellness facilities with sauna and ice bath, and landscaped communal areas. The development also includes retail and dining spaces, creating a self-sufficient environment that combines leisure, wellness, and social experiences within one destination.

The residences feature open-plan layouts with floor-to-ceiling windows, private balconies, and seamless indoor-outdoor living. Interiors are finished with natural materials, earthy tones, and high-quality fittings, emphasizing a connection to the surrounding landscape. Selected units offer ocean views, double-height ceilings, and private rooftop pools, delivering a high level of comfort, privacy, and modern tropical elegance.


##### Parking

Shared parking.


##### Location description and benefits 

Canggu is one of the most vibrant and fast-growing coastal areas on the island of Bali, known for its relaxed atmosphere and strong lifestyle appeal. Once a quiet surf village, it has evolved into a dynamic destination that blends beachside living with modern infrastructure, attracting expats, digital nomads, and investors from around the world.

The area offers a mix of trendy cafes, beach clubs, restaurants, co-working spaces, and boutique shops, creating a lively yet laid-back environment. Popular beaches such as Batu Bolong and Berawa are known for their surf breaks and sunset views, while wellness studios, gyms, and yoga centers support an active and balanced lifestyle.

Canggu continues to see rapid development, with a wide range of private villas, residential complexes, and hospitality projects. Its strategic location provides convenient access to Seminyak and other key parts of Bali, while maintaining a more relaxed and community-oriented atmosphere, making it a highly desirable location for both living and investment.
